name: microsoft/glTF-SDK
description: Microsoft's C++ SDK for reading and writing glTF and glb files with schema validation, embedded Base64 support, and cross-platform compatibility (Windows, macOS, Android).
score_rationale: Solid C++ glTF SDK with 608 stars from Microsoft, but largely inactive since 2022 and superseded by smaller focused libraries for most use cases.
summary: Microsoft C++ SDK for glTF/glb with schema validation and Base64 support
